_about: Every permission the Android and iOS apps declare, with why HANNAH needs it. scripts/check-native-permissions.mjs fails CI when a manifest declares something that isn't here.

android.android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO: Voice turns, calls and the on-device 'Hey HANNAH' wake word. Asked when you first use voice.
android.android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS: Route call audio to the speaker or earpiece and apply echo cancellation during a voice session.
android.android.permission.INTERNET: Reach the HANNAH server, your chosen AI provider, and Ollama or a local model host on your network.

ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Turning your voice into a message with the device's recognizer.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connecting to Ollama or a local model host on your network when you choose local inference.
